question: Without preselecting a consequence variable, where in signed temporal distance around an operator does anonymous relational structure carry transferable information associated with that operator?
claimBoundary: A positive result supports a transferable operator-associated temporal footprint in anonymous local relational structure at one or more predeclared distances. It does not by itself establish causality, semantic meaning, a Hebrew-to-glyph operator correspondence, shared origin, or that the operator is the unique source of the surrounding structure. Failure rejects only this masked local-transition footprint projector under the frozen distances, strata, smoothing, and null.

hebrewSplit.assignment: Sort canonical book osisIDs by sha256(salt + ':' + book). Assign rank modulo 5 residues 0,1,2 TRAIN; 3 holdout; 4 control.

masking.method: For each origin occurrence independently, replace the current operator identity with a sentinel that occurs nowhere else in that temporary sequence before computing any target signature.
masking.reason: Prevent a positive-distance footprint from winning because the literal current operator remains inside the target's four-history window.

signature.definition: At target index j=i+d in the masked sequence, signature = ordered pair [anonymous four-history state immediately before target j, anonymous four-history state immediately after target j].

stratification.baselineKey: signed distance + origin-position bucket + unit-length bin

models.baseline: P(signature | distance, origin-position bucket, unit-length bin)
models.operator: P(signature | operator, distance, origin-position bucket, unit-length bin), hierarchically smoothed toward baseline
models.aggregation: average event gains within operator and distance; average equally across eligible operators to obtain gain_d

null.construction: Within each distance and frozen TRAIN-frequency bin, deterministically permute operator-to-conditional-residual assignments while holding the sealed event signatures, baseline strata, operator vocabulary, operator frequencies, smoothing, support, and residual magnitudes fixed.
null.globalStatistic: positive footprint mass = sum over all predeclared distances of max(gain_d, 0)
null.familywisePeakStatistic: maximum gain_d across all predeclared distances

evaluation.replicationRule: A system supports an operator-associated temporal footprint only if positive footprint mass > 0 and its permutation p<=.05 independently in BOTH sealed holdout and control. Peak location and individual-distance p values are descriptive unless the familywise peak p also passes in both lanes.

directionDiagnostics.centerOfPositiveMass: weighted mean signed distance using max(gain_d,0) as weights

crossSystem.comparison: Pearson correlation of the 24-distance gain curves between one Hebrew representation and glyph identity; no operator pairing.
crossSystem.null: permute glyph signed-distance labels while preserving its gain values
crossSystem.replicationRule: Cross-system footprint alignment requires both compared systems to pass their own footprint gate and curve correlation p<=.05 in BOTH sealed lanes.
